title: Total: total number of books in 2D storage
question: A two-dimensional array `B` stores the number of books in each storage unit. Using nested loops, write a program to calculate and print the total number of books on the whole bookshelf.
analysis: Use a nested loop: outer over rows `i`, inner over columns `j`, accumulate `total += B[i][j]`. For the given B the total is 98.

title: Table: multiplication table 0..10
question: Marco defined a two-dimensional array `M` to store the multiplication table, with `M[i][j]` storing the product of the corresponding numbers from 0 to 10. Fill the table using nested loops and print `M[7][9]`.
analysis: Initialize an 11x11 array then use nested loops to set `M[i][j] = i * j`. `M[7][9]` equals 7*9 = 63.
